title: Surreal Mosaic Fairy
description: A central woman stands in a vibrant, dreamlike scene wearing a mirrored disco-ball mosaic bodysuit with floral patterns and large yellow butterfly wings. She raises one hand while surrounded by floating eyes, jellyfish, a red snake with a melting clock, a golden retriever, an elderly couple on a couch, and various symbolic objects in a fantastical night landscape.
